accountHint: The session cookie is kept in the local credential store only: it is never written to config and never echoed back.
authExpired: Session expired, please sign in again
csrfHint: Copy it from a signed-in Overleaf tab; leave empty to let the host handle it.
localRootHint: Leave empty to use the default folder: expanded from the default folder pattern, and link omits localRoot.
pickerUnavailable: This host has no system folder picker (the browser and the Host are not on the same machine), so type the path and use "Check path".
forceBody: {path} is not this project's folder and already has content. Confirm to bind with force mode.
gitAutoInit: Create a git repository after pulling
gitIncludeBinary: Include binary files in the first commit
localRootPatternHint: The {project} placeholder is replaced with the project name.
watchAutoStart: Watch a document when it opens
watchIdleLeaveDocMs: Idle timeout before leaving a document (ms)
conflictNotice: The configuration changed elsewhere; refresh and retry.
effectNotice: Some changes take effect on the next sync.
readOnlyNotice: The host does not provide the Settings service, so this page is read-only.
hostNotReadyHint: No /overleaf/api route was found; check that the plugin's host half is enabled.
projectRequired: Select an Overleaf project to bind first.
syncHint: Linking only records project ↔ folder; files are written by Pull, and local edits go up with Push. Background watching is not enabled yet.
syncUnlinked: No project linked yet — pick one in “Project” above, choose a folder, then press Link.
pullNothing: Already up to date: nothing to pull.
syncDryRun: Preview: {pushed} file(s) would be pushed (nothing written)
syncConflicts: {count} conflict copy/copies created (*.remote-<timestamp>) — merge them by hand
linkedOnly: Linked to {root} — press Pull below to download the remote files.
sbUnlinkedHint: Pick a project and a local folder under Settings → Overleaf sync, then link it; status shows up here.
sbPullConfirm: You have {count} local change(s) not pushed yet; pulling may overwrite them. Pull anyway?
